from pathlib import Path
import json

root = Path('products/services/sqlite-original-paid-exercise')
execution = json.loads((root / 'director-candidate/execution.json').read_text())
transfer = json.loads((root / 'transfer-check.json').read_text())
archive_hash = '76bdf9b059b77ee575f4c3fed3787059a07a0b2bf78e8babb4bee282d30bf08c'
assert execution['archive_sha256'] == transfer['archive_sha256'] == archive_hash
assert transfer['state'] == 'PASS' and transfer['fictional_data'] is True
assert set(execution['members']) == {'README.md', 'seed.sql', 'exercise.sql', 'solution.sql', 'check.py'}
controls = execution['clean_extraction_controls']
assert controls['exercise.sql']['exit'] == 1 and controls['solution.sql']['exit'] == 0
packet = {'state': 'private_checkout_acceptance_packet', 'archive_sha256': archive_hash, 'members_sha256': {name: detail['sha256'] for name, detail in execution['members'].items()}, 'observed_offline_controls': controls, 'sqlite_version': transfer['sqlite_version'], 'fictional_changed_data_control': transfer['mutations'], 'before_activation': ['Record the authorized seller decision for redistribution of this exact archive.', 'Confirm seller eligibility and the selected payment and payout setup against current official terms.', 'Obtain independent review of the exact public release.'], 'test_mode_if_officially_supported': ['Use only the authorized platform test checkout.', 'Download the delivered file through the buyer path and compare its SHA-256 and exact member hashes with this packet.', 'Extract into an empty directory and follow the buyer README. Confirm the starter fails and the solution passes on the documented fixture.', 'Save a redacted test receipt with the archive hash and control exits. Record any live sale, payout and Treasury settlement separately.'], 'checkout_result': 'unobserved'}
output = root / 'checkout-delivery-acceptance.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(packet, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads(output.read_text()) == packet
print(output.read_text())

description: The original SQLite archive passed clean-extraction controls and a changed-data test. That supports preparing an exact checkout delivery check and a private listing decision with documented fees and payout terms. Listing activation depends on seller authorization and verified platform eligibility. The catalogue update has a reproduced dry-run digest and can advance when an eligible independent approval is recorded. Feedback has zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury reports no verified available funds or revenue.
